name: What are common design trends for modern bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are common design trends for modern bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom design trends often focus on clean lines, natural materials, and smart technology. Popular elements include large-format tiles, floating vanities, walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures, and freestanding tubs. Earthy tones, matte finishes, and wood accents are prevalent. Smart features like motion-sensor lighting, heated floors, and digital shower controls also enhance functionality and comfort. The goal is usually a spa-like, minimalist, and highly functional space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern bathroom trends feature clean lines, natural materials, floating vanities, walk-in showers, and smart tech, aiming for a minimalist, spa-like feel.
